notes.title: Investigation 1 Year Anniversary Update! V.6
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who has purchased Investigation and played it in the past year!!! I've been working hard in the background on a new game; Hollowed Echo, while completely remaking Investigation! New engine, new features, new game. I upgraded from Unreal Engine 4.27 to 5.3! I understand how broken Investigation was, and I wasn't happy with the end result. So let me breakdown what will come out on this update! (Within the next 2 weeks)


Complete map overhaul- EVERYTHING has been revamped, and made better fit for the narrative

Graphics overhaul- Experience the horror like never before! The graphics have been severely bumped up!

New story elements- Explains plot holes from the original build I left out. This will expand on and have a better understanding of what "The Hospital" scene actually is!

New monsters- New monsters with unique AI will be included!!!

Hiding/sneaking mechanics- To make it more fair, hiding and sneaking will be added to prevent the player from feeling like it's too hard!

New cutscenes- All new cutscenes to tie into the gameplay better!

Reduced flashing lights- I will be HEAVILY reducing the strobe lighting to avoid causing epilepsy and eye strain.

Improved settings menu- turn down bodycam effect, camera grain, gore remover, and brightness settings will all be accessible!

AND SO, SO MUCH MORE!
Have fun detectives!!!

-ShockyyDoc
